comparison.objective: Remove a wrench from a mixer bowl before starting the mixer; not calibrate a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Foreign-object retrieval followed by ordered button actuation, without retained-adjuster manipulation or response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Wrench out before start; run light green. Clearance and light-state thresholds are not detailed. Candidate requires safe isolation during adjustment and two compliant cycles afterward.
comparison.reason: Although both prohibit unsafe energization, pre-start inspection/removal is a different physical task.
